summary: This is a Makefile snippet that defines two build targets: one to update PHP dependencies (composer.lock), and another to install them (vendor directory). The first target runs when composer.json changes, ensuring the lock file stays in sync; the second runs when the lock file changes, installing those specific versions into the vendor folder.

explanations.1: This line declares that composer.lock depends on composer.json — if composer.json is newer, this target needs to run.
explanations.2: ${CMD} is a variable (likely defined elsewhere in the Makefile) that runs the actual command; composer update regenerates the lock file based on your requirements.
explanations.4: This declares that the vendor directory depends on composer.lock — if the lock file changes, we need to reinstall packages.
explanations.5: composer install reads from the lock file and installs the exact versions specified there into the vendor directory.
